The image focuses primarily on the head and upper torso, showcasing detailed scale texture, a prominent subtympanic shield, and a dorsal crest of spines.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head shape is clearly visible and consistent with Iguana iguana morphology. While the full extent of the dewlap is partially obscured by the angle and resting position, the throat region shows the characteristic loose skin structure associated with the dewlap.

The visible portion of the torso and neck indicates a thick, muscular build consistent with a robust adult iguana.
